title: Garsa Fwip
description: Garsa Fwip was a stunning Twi'lek, always charming and lavishly dressed. She was the proprietor of Garsa's Sanctuary—an oasis in the dusty streets of Mos Espa. She was there with all the grace and warmth of a seasoned host to greet guests. She paid protection money to the daimyo of the territory—Boba Fett, who gained control when the club was bombed by the Pyke Syndicate.
